intro: A selection of devices for your new office in London – sorted by category.

products.title: Brother HL-L2375DW
products.recommendation: The best balance of price and toner cost for your volume. Has run reliably for years in similar setups.

products.title: No-name inkjet printer model with no further technical specs and an exceptionally long product name for testing purposes
products.recommendation: A very detailed, deliberately oversized recommendation text meant to check how the product card handles a lot more running text than would be typical day to day – including several sentences, commas, and an em dash, so line wrapping and card height in the plain theme become visible under realistic load.

products.title: Desk monitor without an image
